001package com.streamConverter.examples;
002
003import com.streamConverter.CommandResult;
004import com.streamConverter.StreamConverter;
005import com.streamConverter.command.IStreamCommand;
006import com.streamConverter.command.impl.csv.CsvNavigateCommand;
007import com.streamConverter.command.impl.json.JsonNavigateCommand;
008import com.streamConverter.command.impl.xml.XmlNavigateCommand;
009import com.streamConverter.command.rule.PassThroughRule;
010import com.streamConverter.path.CSVPath;
011import com.streamConverter.path.JSONPath;
012import com.streamConverter.path.XPath;
013import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
014import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
015import java.io.IOException;
016import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
017import java.util.List;
018import org.slf4j.Logger;
019import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
020
021/**
022 * 直接的なAPI使用のデモンストレーション
023 *
024 * <p>StreamConverterとEnhancedCommandFactoryを使用した 処理パイプラインの構築方法を示します。
025 * 流暢なAPIの代替として、より直接的で明示的なアプローチを紹介します。
026 */
027public class DirectApiDemo {
028
029  private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DirectApiDemo.class);
030
031  /**
032   * 直接APIデモのメインメソッド
033   *
034   * @param args コマンドライン引数（使用されません）
035   */
036  public static void main(String[] args) {
037    logger.info("🔧 StreamConverter - Direct API Demo");
038    logger.info("====================================\n");
039
040    try {
041      // Demo 1: Basic CSV processing
042      basicCsvProcessingDemo();
043
044      // Demo 2: JSON processing
045      jsonProcessingDemo();
046
047      // Demo 3: XML processing
048      xmlProcessingDemo();
049
050      // Demo 4: Complex pipeline
051      complexPipelineDemo();
052
053    } catch (Exception e) {
054      logger.error("Demo failed: " + e.getMessage());
055      e.printStackTrace();
056    }
057  }
058
059  /** Demo 1: 基本的なCSV処理 */
060  private static void basicCsvProcessingDemo() throws IOException {
061    logger.info("📊 Basic CSV Processing");
062    logger.info("========================");
063
064    String employeeData =
065        "employee_id,name,department,salary\n"
066            + "E001,John Smith,Engineering,75000\n"
067            + "E002,Jane Doe,Marketing,65000\n"
068            + "E003,Bob Johnson,Engineering,80000";
069
070    // CSV名前抽出パイプライン
071    IStreamCommand csvCommand = new CsvNavigateCommand(new CSVPath("name"), new PassThroughRule());
072    StreamConverter converter = new StreamConverter(new IStreamCommand[] {csvCommand});
073
074    String result = processString(converter, employeeData);
075
076    logger.info("📋 Employee names extracted:");
077    logger.info(result);
078    logger.info("");
079  }
080
081  /** Demo 2: JSON処理 */
082  private static void jsonProcessingDemo() throws IOException {
083    logger.info("🔍 JSON Processing");
084    logger.info("===================");
085
086    String jsonData =
087        """
088        {
089            "user": {
090                "name": "Alice Johnson",
091                "email": "alice@example.com",
092                "preferences": {
093                    "theme": "dark",
094                    "notifications": true
095                }
096            }
097        }
098        """;
099
100    // JSONパス抽出
101    IStreamCommand jsonCommand =
102        new JsonNavigateCommand(new JSONPath("$.user.name"), new PassThroughRule());
103    StreamConverter converter = new StreamConverter(new IStreamCommand[] {jsonCommand});
104
105    String result = processString(converter, jsonData);
106
107    logger.info("👤 User name extracted:");
108    logger.info(result);
109    logger.info("");
110  }
111
112  /** Demo 3: XML処理 */
113  private static void xmlProcessingDemo() throws IOException {
114    logger.info("📄 XML Processing");
115    logger.info("==================");
116
117    String xmlData =
118        """
119        <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
120        <product>
121            <id>P001</id>
122            <name>Laptop Computer</name>
123            <category>Electronics</category>
124            <price currency="USD">999.99</price>
125        </product>
126        """;
127
128    // XML要素抽出
129    IStreamCommand xmlCommand = new XmlNavigateCommand(new XPath("//name"), new PassThroughRule());
130    StreamConverter converter = new StreamConverter(new IStreamCommand[] {xmlCommand});
131
132    String result = processString(converter, xmlData);
133
134    logger.info("🛒 Product name extracted:");
135    logger.info(result);
136    logger.info("");
137  }
138
139  /** Demo 4: 複合パイプライン */
140  private static void complexPipelineDemo() throws IOException {
141    logger.info("🔗 Complex Pipeline");
142    logger.info("===================");
143
144    String csvData =
145        "id,data\n"
146            + "1,'{\"message\":\"Hello World\",\"status\":\"active\"}'\n"
147            + "2,'{\"message\":\"Goodbye\",\"status\":\"inactive\"}'";
148
149    // 複合パイプライン: CSV -> JSON抽出
150    IStreamCommand[] commands = {
151      new CsvNavigateCommand(new CSVPath("data"), new PassThroughRule()),
152      new JsonNavigateCommand(new JSONPath("$.message"), new PassThroughRule())
153    };
154
155    StreamConverter converter = new StreamConverter(commands);
156    String result = processString(converter, csvData);
157
158    logger.info("💬 Messages extracted from CSV->JSON pipeline:");
159    logger.info(result);
160    logger.info("");
161  }
162
163  /**
164   * 文字列データを処理してStreamConverterで変換
165   *
166   * @param converter StreamConverterインスタンス
167   * @param inputData 入力文字列データ
168   * @return 処理結果の文字列
169   * @throws IOException I/O例外
170   */
171  private static String processString(StreamConverter converter, String inputData)
172      throws IOException {
173    try (ByteArrayInputStream inputStream =
174            new ByteArrayInputStream(inputData.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
175        ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
176
177      List<CommandResult> results = converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
178      CommandResult result = results.get(0);
179
180      if (result.isSuccess()) {
181        return outputStream.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
182      } else {
183        logger.warn("Processing failed: {}", result.getErrorMessage());
184        return "Processing failed: " + result.getErrorMessage();
185      }
186    }
187  }
188}
